use codegen_runtime::{Instance, Value};

mod xml_tree;
mod oracle_controls;

#[derive(Debug)]
struct InputFailure { category: String, detail: String }

fn xml_failure(error: codegen_runtime::XmlBoundaryError) -> InputFailure {
    InputFailure { category: format!("{:?}", error.kind), detail: format!("{error:?}") }
}

fn x12_failure(error: codegen_runtime::X12BoundaryError) -> InputFailure {
    let category = match &error {
        codegen_runtime::X12BoundaryError::Syntax { .. } => "Syntax",
        _ => "unexpected X12 error",
    };
    InputFailure { category: category.into(), detail: format!("{error:?}") }
}

fn verify(actual: &Instance, expected: &serde_json::Value) {
    match expected {
        serde_json::Value::Object(fields) => {
            let Instance::Group(actual_fields) = actual else { panic!("expected group") };
            assert_eq!(actual_fields.len(), fields.len());
            for ((actual_name, actual_value), (expected_name, expected_value)) in actual_fields.iter().zip(fields) {
                assert_eq!(actual_name, expected_name, "ordered typed output field differs");
                verify(actual_value, expected_value);
            }
        }
        serde_json::Value::Array(items) => {
            let actual = actual.as_repeated().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(actual.len(), items.len());
            for (actual, expected) in actual.iter().zip(items) { verify(actual, expected); }
        }
        serde_json::Value::String(text) => assert_eq!(actual.as_scalar(), Some(&Value::String(text.clone()))),
        serde_json::Value::Number(number) => assert_eq!(actual.as_scalar(), Some(&Value::Int(number.as_i64().unwrap()))),
        _ => panic!("outside authored output domain"),
    }
}

fn typed_oracle_control() {
    let expected: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"Included":0,"Excluded":0}"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(expected.as_object().unwrap().keys().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["Included", "Excluded"]);
    let ordered = Instance::Group(vec![
        ("Included".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Int(0))),
        ("Excluded".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Int(0))),
    ].into());
    let swapped = Instance::Group(vec![
        ("Excluded".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Int(0))),
        ("Included".into(), Instance::Scalar(Value::Int(0))),
    ].into());
    verify(&ordered, &expected);
    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| verify(&swapped, &expected)).is_err(), "swapped equal-valued fields escaped typed oracle");
}

fn main() {
    // Fixture-independent assertion controls; no mapping call or synthetic mapping input.
    typed_oracle_control();
    oracle_controls::assert_xml_oracle_controls();
    eprintln!("filtered-count oracle controls completed: ordered typed group and schema-independent XML");
    let cases: Vec<serde_json::Value> = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../cases.json")).unwrap();
    let source = include_str!("../source-schema.json");
    let target = include_str!("../target-schema.json");
    let kind = include_str!("../input-kind.txt");
    for case in &cases {
        let input = case["input"].as_str().unwrap();
        let (text, bytes) = match kind {
            "xml" => (
                codegen_runtime::parse_structured_xml(source, input).map_err(xml_failure),
                codegen_runtime::parse_structured_xml_bytes(source, input.as_bytes()).map_err(xml_failure),
            ),
            "x12" => (
                codegen_runtime::parse_x12(source, input).map_err(x12_failure),
                codegen_runtime::parse_x12_bytes(source, input.as_bytes()).map_err(x12_failure),
            ),
            _ => panic!("unknown authored input cohort"),
        };
        if case["reject"] == true {
            assert_eq!(case["stage"], "input");
            for (boundary, result) in [("text", text), ("utf8", bytes)] {
                let error = result.expect_err("invalid input reached mapping");
                println!("{}", serde_json::json!({"case":case["name"],"boundary":boundary,
                    "stage":"input","category":error.category,"error":error.detail}));
                assert_eq!(error.category, case["runtimeCategory"].as_str().unwrap());
            }
            continue;
        }
        let (text, bytes) = (text.unwrap(), bytes.unwrap());
        assert_eq!(text, bytes);
        for (boundary, input) in [("text", &text), ("utf8", &bytes)] {
            let before = input.clone();
            for attempt in 1..=2 {
                // The real ordinary generated mapping, not an oracle-backed surrogate.
                let outcome = ferrule_filtered_counts::execute(input);
                eprintln!("{} {boundary} {attempt} mapping outcome: {outcome:?}", case["name"]);
                let output = outcome.unwrap();
                eprintln!("typed output {} {boundary} {attempt}: {output:?}", case["name"]);
                let json = codegen_runtime::serialize_json(target, &output).unwrap();
                let xml = case.get("expectedXml").map(|_| {
                    let outcome = codegen_runtime::serialize_xml_document(target, &output, true, false, None, None);
                    eprintln!("{} {boundary} {attempt} XML outcome: {outcome:?}", case["name"]);
                    outcome.unwrap()
                });
                println!("{}", serde_json::json!({"case":case["name"],"boundary":boundary,"attempt":attempt,
                    "stage":"mapping","output":serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&json).unwrap(),"xml":xml}));
                // Complete actuals are written before the whole-value assertions.
                assert_eq!(input, &before);
                verify(&output, &case["expected"]);
                assert_eq!(serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&json).unwrap(), case["expected"]);
                if let Some(expected) = case["expectedXml"].as_str() {
                    xml_tree::assert_xml(xml.as_deref().unwrap(), expected);
                    let expected = codegen_runtime::parse_structured_xml(target, expected).unwrap();
                    let serialized = codegen_runtime::parse_structured_xml(target, xml.as_deref().unwrap()).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(serialized, expected);
                    assert_eq!(serialized, output);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    println!("filtered-count {kind} Release cases: {}", cases.len());
}
